description.summary: This table defines key terms used in the 'משכנתא בטוחה' (Mortgage Safe) home insurance policy. It clarifies what is considered a 'בית משותף' (shared building), 'בני משפחה בדירה' (family members in the apartment), and what constitutes the 'דירה' (apartment) itself for insurance purposes.
